documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
Disclosures under Reg. 29(1) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011

analysis.summary: Bajaj Auto Limited reported its highest quarterly performance for Q1 FY27, recording 1.4 million unit volumes, revenue of INR 17,244 crores, EBITDA of INR 3,596 crores, and consolidated PAT of INR 3,226 crores. These results were achieved despite raw material inflation, supply chain disruptions, and a temporary operational pause caused by a cyber security incident that reduced availability by 10% to 15%. Management announced plans to expand total production capacity from 7 million to 9 million units per annum across businesses. Further, the company is undertaking an extensive product refresh in domestic motorcycles over the next six weeks while targeting monthly export volumes above 250,000 units. Bajaj Auto reported record performance for FY26, with revenues exceeding INR 58,000 crores and EBITDA crossing INR 12,000 crores.

guidance.claim: Bajaj Auto aims to move monthly export volumes beyond 250,000 units per month starting in Q2 FY27.
guidance.quote: we are looking at moving exports to beyond the 2,50,000 per month level this quarter and onwards.

guidance.claim: The company targets completing an exhaustive portfolio makeover in domestic motorcycles within six weeks.
guidance.quote: Our aim is to accomplish this exhaustive portfolio makeover within the next 6 weeks.

guidance.claim: Bajaj Auto plans to launch two new brands in the 125cc segment later in the financial year.
guidance.quote: Further, in the year, we aim to introduce 2 new brands in the 125cc segment to cover the full spectrum of customers in this large segment as well as proposition customers from the 100cc segment to upgrade.

guidance.claim: The company aims to increase its monthly export volume to over 220,000 units in the current quarter.
guidance.quote: We are looking at moving the exports needle to 2,20,000 units per month this quarter, up from the 2,00,000 levels.

guidance.claim: Management estimates that the motorcycle category growth will slow down to between 7% and 9% in the near term.
guidance.quote: This is bound to slow down the motorcycle category from its rocking 20% growth in Q4 to we estimate 7% to 9% in the near term.

guidance.claim: The company expects its growth momentum to continue in the first quarter of the fiscal year.
guidance.quote: Keeping all the above in perspective, as also our actual April outcomes, we expect our growth tempo to actually continue in Q1 basis the strong competitive positions we enjoy in the key segments like the 150cc plus in domestic motorcycles, the EV business, both in 2-wheelers and 3-wheelers and the continued performance in large and stable territories like Latam and parts of Asia.

guidance.claim: Management expects the results of the KTM turnaround plan to begin appearing in the latter part of 2026.
guidance.quote: I expect the results of this to start showing up in the latter part of 2026 itself.

guidance.claim: The management expects the motorcycle industry to continue growing at around 12% to 15%.
guidance.quote: We expect this growth momentum in the industry to continue and the motorcycle industry to continue to grow at, say, 12% to 15%.

guidance.claim: The export business is on track to deliver its highest ever top line performance in USD terms this financial year.
guidance.quote: In fact, the business is on the path to deliver its highest ever top line performance in USD terms this financial year.

guidance.claim: The management anticipates material cost inflation impact of between 50 to 60 basis points for the current quarter.
guidance.quote: At the start of the quarter, we had anticipated an impact of anywhere between 50 to 60 basis points for which we have taken certain pricing actions across the portfolio to offset about half this impact so far.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the overall demand environment in both domestic and international markets remains very positive.
demand_outlook.quote: Having said that, the demand environment, both in domestic and international, particularly in our key markets, is very positive, though the business environment may still be a bit volatile.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic two-wheeler industry registrations grew 14% year-on-year in Q1.
demand_outlook.quote: The two-wheeler industry turned in a resilient performance as registrations grew by 14% year-on-year in quarter 1, though much lower than the 25% growth of quarter 4, but under the circumstances, a very healthy performance.

demand_outlook.claim: African markets grew by nearly 50% year-on-year while Bajaj Auto doubled its retail sales in the region.
demand_outlook.quote: African markets did very well, growing by almost 50% and we grew by twice that rate.

demand_outlook.claim: The domestic three-wheeler industry grew by 11% year-on-year in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: In commercial vehicles, the three-wheeler industry, including e-ricks, grew by 11% year-on- year, driven by a doubling of sales of e-autos, which now constitute 44% of the L5 segment.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand environment softened in April due to factors like inflation, vehicle price increases, and LPG shortages.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment, it has softened in April due to general inflation, increased prices of our vehicles, LPG shortages, manpower migration and the LPG shortage-led effect on the consumer sentiment.

demand_outlook.claim: The electric category in both 3-wheelers and 2-wheelers is expected to see continued or increased growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Secondly, the electric category in both 3-wheelers and 2-wheelers will witness not just continuity of growth, but perhaps a further increase in growth.

demand_outlook.claim: The electric scooter segment grew by 40% in Q4 and accelerated to over 60% growth in April.
demand_outlook.quote: The E-segment, scooter segment grew by 40% in Q4 and has continued to grow at an even higher rate of 60% plus in April, far outpacing the growth of ICE scooters.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the electric 3-wheeler industry continues to drive growth by expanding at over 50%.
demand_outlook.quote: The Electric segment continues to drive the 3-wheeler industry by growing at about 50% plus.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed that the top 30 overseas markets grew by about 10% during the quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: The top 30 overseas markets collectively accounting for nearly 75% of the emerging market, industry grew by about 10% in this quarter with our sales growing at 15%, thereby signalling an increase of market share in these key markets.

capex_expansion.claim: Bajaj Auto is expanding its overall annual production capacity from 7 million units to 9 million units.
capex_expansion.quote: So, with an eye on the future, we are undertaking an expansion of capacity by almost 25% from the current 7 million units per annum across different businesses to progressively go up to 9 million units per annum.

capex_expansion.claim: The company foresees expanding its exclusive Chetak store network to 1,000 outlets over the next couple of years.
capex_expansion.quote: I can see 1,000 stores coming in a couple of years.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure for the year was approximately INR 500 crores, divided equally between ICE and EV investments.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex for the year was approximately INR500 crores, split equally between ICE and EV investments.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is working on expanding its capacity for larger 3-wheelers.
capex_expansion.quote: And this is another area where we are now getting capacity limited, and we are working to expand the capacity, particularly the larger 3-wheelers.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is evaluating options to substantially expand its Chetak production capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: There is some serious work going on to see how and where we should expand capacity in a quantum manner.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone EBITDA margin reached 20.9% in Q1 FY27, improving 10 basis points sequentially.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins inched up to 20.9%, an improvement of 10 basis points sequentially despite the hyperinflationary commodity environment that I'd spoken about.

margins_costs.claim: Commodity cost inflation impacted Q1 FY27 by approximately 4.5% of revenue.
margins_costs.quote: Inflation across the metals complex accelerated meaningfully through May, taking the overall inflationary impact for the quarter to about 4.5% of revenue.

margins_costs.claim: Bajaj Auto offset nearly half of the commodity cost inflation through calibrated price increases in April and June.
margins_costs.quote: And as I had indicated in the previous call, we responded with calibrated pricing very judiciously taken through April and June, enabling us to offset nearly about half of the inflation through pricing.

margins_costs.claim: The company estimates a material cost inflation impact of about 3.5% to 4% of revenue for the first quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Taken together, we are currently estimating a material cost inflation impact of approximately 3.5% to 4% of revenue.

margins_costs.claim: Pricing actions have been taken to offset approximately 40% of the estimated cost inflation impact.
margins_costs.quote: Once again, we have taken very judicious pricing actions to offset about 40% of this impact so far.

margins_costs.claim: The electric portfolio achieved a double-digit EBITDA margin in its entirety for the first time during the year.
margins_costs.quote: Underpinning the margin delivery was a significant development that we have made on our electric portfolio, which hit double-digit EBITDA margin in its entirety for the very first time in the course of this year.

margins_costs.claim: The cost environment is experiencing a potential rise of 3% to 5% during the quarter, driven by metals.
margins_costs.quote: The cost environment is seeing a potential rise during the quarter of about 3% to 5%, driven by the metal complex.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins expanded by 30 basis points sequentially to reach 20.8%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins expanded to 20.8%, up 30 basis points sequentially.

margins_costs.claim: Average dollar realization for the quarter stood at 88.3 compared to 87.1 in quarter 2.
margins_costs.quote: Currency remained a tailwind during this quarter, and I've spoken about this the last time we have met, with average dollar realization for the quarter standing at 88.3, compared to 87.1 in quarter 2 and 84.3 a year ago.

orders_capacity.claim: Bajaj Auto achieved record quarterly volume sales of 1.4 million units in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Volumes at 1.4 million, revenue of INR17,000 crores, EBITDA of INR3,500 crores and PAT of INR3,000 crores, along with EBITDA margins of 20.9%.

orders_capacity.claim: Export volumes reached a record high of 732,000 units in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Exports business unit, the business unit established a new high of 7,32,000 units in the quarter and USD 735 million revenue in the quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: Three-wheeler exports registered a record volume of 100,000 units in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Three-wheeler exports delivered a record of 100,000 units, growing by almost 70%, commanding a dominant market share of over 65% of three-wheeler exports from India, and our growth of secular across regions in mature as well as nascent markets.

orders_capacity.claim: Electric two-wheeler capacity is currently constrained at 50,000 units per month.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we are right now at 50,000 units. We are limited at that for EV two-wheelers.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has reached a Chetak production capacity of 50,000 units per month.
orders_capacity.quote: And we have now a capacity of 50,000 units per month.

orders_capacity.claim: Manufacturing capacity in Brazil has been expanded to 60,000 units per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Brazil. Sales nearly 10,000 units during the quarter, supported by expanded manufacturing capacity, which has now increased to 60,000 units per annum, successful new product introductions like the 400 NS and wider market presence with almost 70 top-class stores.

orders_capacity.claim: The Chetak retail network has expanded to over 850 cities with more than 500 exclusive stores.
orders_capacity.quote: The reach of Chetak today stands at 500-plus exclusive Chetak stores, combined with almost 3,000-plus motorcycle stores, which are shared with Chetak, and this presence has expanded to over 850 cities.

orders_capacity.claim: Exports volume crossed the 600,000 units mark during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: The BU crossed the 200,000 average per month sales level in October '25 after nearly 40 months and maintained this level through the remainder of the quarter, surpassing the 600,000 units mark after 15 quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: Assets under management for BACL stood at nearly INR16,500 crores as of December end.
orders_capacity.quote: Assets under management stood at nearly INR16,500 crores as of December end.

capital_allocation.claim: Bajaj Auto generated over INR 2,300 crores of free cash flow in Q1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated over INR2,300 crores of free cash flow during this quarter, almost double that of the same period last year, translating into a cash conversion of almost 80% of profit after tax.

capital_allocation.claim: Surplus cash on the balance sheet stood in excess of INR 21,000 crores as of June 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The balance sheet continues to remain very healthy with surplus cash in excess of INR21,000 crores at the end of the June quarter, well managed and providing sufficient fuel for future growth investments, strategic opportunities and improved shareholder returns.

capital_allocation.claim: The company paid out approximately INR 10,000 crores to shareholders in July 2026 through dividend and share buyback.
capital_allocation.quote: Cumulatively, both those corporate actions put together would mean that INR10,000 crores in July would have been paid out to shareholders, right, which essentially will mean that cash will dip from the under INR21,000 crores that existed at the end of June.

capital_allocation.claim: The company ended the year with surplus funds exceeding INR 18,000 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We closed the year with surplus funds of over INR18,000 crores after deploying capital on multiple fronts during the year, reflecting a strong and consistent cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: The board approved a final dividend of INR 150 per share and a buyback of about INR 5,633 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: his will be split as follows a final dividend of INR150 per share that will aggregate to INR4,192 crores and the balance of about INR5,633 crores will be towards a buyback under the tender route at a buyback price of INR12,000 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: The company invested over INR 2,300 crores between BACL and BAIH BV.
capital_allocation.quote: We invested over INR2,300 crores between BACL and BAIH BV, the former to support the scaling of the lending book and the latter in furtherance of the KTM transaction.

capital_allocation.claim: The company closed the quarter with surplus cash of about INR15,000 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to deliver strong and consistent cash generation, closing the quarter with surplus cash of about INR15,000 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: In the first 9 months of the year, the company generated nearly INR5,200 crores of free cash flow.
capital_allocation.quote: It's also worth noting that in the first 9 months of this year, we've generated nearly INR5,200 crores of free cash flow, and that was up 70% over the same period last year, reflecting our strong track record of converting profit to cash.

risks_headwinds.claim: Supply chain, logistics disruptions, and a ransomware attack combined to impair volume availabilities by 10% to 15%.
risks_headwinds.quote: All of these above issues combined impaired availabilities by about 10% to 15%, more so in exports, high-end bikes and EVs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Cost pressures broadened across proprietary components, electronics, labour, logistics, and conversion costs during Q1 FY27.
risks_headwinds.quote: The cost pressures have become more broader, with proprietary components, electronics, electrical parts, labour, logistics and energy and conversion now moving up simultaneously and meaningfully.

risks_headwinds.claim: Industrial LPG supply curtailments created fuel availability challenges early in the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: To start with, fuel availability became a significant challenge early in the quarter following the curtailment of industrial LPG supplies.

risks_headwinds.claim: Supply chain issues, including LPG shortages and manpower migration, reduced the company's ability to service demand by 10% to 15%.
risks_headwinds.quote: Supply chain difficulties in terms of the LPG shortage, manpower availability and outbound logistics to overseas markets have impaired availability to service demand by about 10% to 15%.

risks_headwinds.claim: The E-Rick segment has experienced a slowdown due to the enforcement of street regulations.
risks_headwinds.quote: Though the E-Rick segment itself has slowed down due to enforcement of regulation on the streets, which is actually helping consolidate this industry in favour of the larger and better OEMs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical issues in the Middle East have resulted in lost sales in the Gulf region.
risks_headwinds.quote: Of course, we have lost sale in the Middle East because there's nothing going over there to the Gulf country, but that's 5,000 – 6,000 units per month out of the overall 200 plus.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management recognized INR61 crores as a onetime exceptional charge towards past service cost arising from the new labour code.
risks_headwinds.quote: As you're all aware, pursuant to the amendment in the definition of wages under the new labour code, we recognized INR61 crores as a onetime exceptional charge towards the past service cost arising from the changes introduced under the new labour code.

management_commitments.claim: Bajaj Auto aims to complete its domestic motorcycle portfolio makeover within six weeks.
management_commitments.quote: Our aim is to accomplish this exhaustive portfolio makeover within the next 6 weeks.

management_commitments.claim: Bajaj Auto aims to introduce two new 125cc brands later in the financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Further, in the year, we aim to introduce 2 new brands in the 125cc segment to cover the full spectrum of customers in this large segment as well as proposition customers from the 100cc segment to upgrade.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to expand Chetak exclusive stores to 1,000 in a couple of years.
management_commitments.quote: I can see 1,000 stores coming in a couple of years.

management_commitments.claim: Bajaj Auto is expanding its total capacity from 7 million to 9 million units per annum.
management_commitments.quote: So, with an eye on the future, we are undertaking an expansion of capacity by almost 25% from the current 7 million units per annum across different businesses to progressively go up to 9 million units per annum.

management_commitments.claim: The team will focus on gaining market share in the 125cc plus and 150cc plus segments through Q1 and the rest of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Through Q1 and rest of FY27, the team will remain absolutely focused on the areas which I've highlighted earlier, gaining share in the 125cc plus segment, particularly in the 150cc plus segment riding the continued industry growth.

management_commitments.claim: The company is looking to increase monthly exports to over 220,000 units in the current quarter.
management_commitments.quote: We are looking at moving the exports needle to 2,20,000 units per month this quarter, up from the 2,00,000 levels.

management_commitments.claim: The top management team build for KTM AG will be completed by 1st April.
management_commitments.quote: The top deck is now largely in place, and the exercise will be completed by 1st April.

management_commitments.claim: Joint KTM-Triumph showrooms will be expanded to over 100 by March.
management_commitments.quote: We currently have about 50 KT showrooms operational and plan to expand these to over 100 by March.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
